content: अभिसंधा €3 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To hold together .²2 To acknowledge, recognize; own. .²3 To fit or fix a missile, arrow <ab>&c.</ab> to the bow. .²4 To throw or shoot at, aim at; (शूलं) चिक्षेप परमक्रुद्धो लक्ष्मणायाभिसंहितम् <ls>Rām.</ls> .²5 To aim at, have in view, think of, (with <ab>acc.</ab>); पदाविद्धं यान्ती स्खलितमभिसंधाय बहुशः <ls>V. 4. 52</ls> calling to mind, thinking of my fault; ऋष्यमूकमभिसंधाय <ls>Mv. 5</ls> towards, in the direction of; <ls>Mv. 6</ls>; <ls>Bg. 17. 12</ls>, <ls n="Bg. 17.">25</ls>; sometimes with <ab>dat.</ab>; अभिसंदधते ये च विश्वासायास्य मानवाः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²6 To deceive, cheat, जनं विद्वानेकः सकलमभिसंधाय <ls>Māl. 1. 14</ls>. .²7 To come to an understanding or agreement; फलं त्वनभिसंधाय <ls>Ms. 9. 52</ls> (एवं यत्र नियमो न कृतः). .²8 To win over, make friendship with, ally oneself with; अभिसंधातुमारेभे हनूमानङ्गदं ततः <ls>Rām. 4. 54. 5</ls>; तान् सर्वानभिसंदध्यात्सामादिभिरुपक्रमैः <ls>Ms. 7. 159</ls> (वशीकुर्यात्). .²9 To declare solemnly, agree, promise. .²10 To calumniate, traduce. .²11 To add. .²12 To prefer.
अभिसंधा .²1 Speech, declaration; word, assertion, promise; तस्य सत्याभिसंधस्य वृद्धस्य वचनात् पितुः <ls>Rām. 5. 31. 7</ls> true to his word. .²2 Deceit.
